behavior: `NumberField.ScrubAreaCursor` renders the portal element of the cursor in the root node of its scrub area: in the shadow root that holds the scrub area, or else in the `<body>` of the document of the scrub area. The styles of a shadow root thus reach the cursor, and in a frame the cursor is in the document of the pointer. The scrub area puts the cursor at the pointer also when an ancestor of the cursor, such as an ancestor of the shadow host with a transform, is the containing block of the cursor, and when that block moves during a scrub. Base UI renders the cursor in the `<body>` of the global document. There, the styles of a shadow root do not reach it, and in a frame it is in another document.
